scope: Read-only one-second NVML samples. Nonzero utilization is sampled hardware activity, not application throughput or sustained efficiency. Includes loading, JIT gaps, and idle periods. No energy saving conclusion.
utilization_interpretation: Eight simultaneously allocated GPU workers occurred. The one-second monitor did not observe all eight GPUs with nonzero utilization in the same sample; peak sampled compute concurrency was seven. JIT, planning and short kernels prevent claiming sustained full utilization.
